title: Effect of NAC and MPA ligands on growth process and optical properties of CdTe quantum dots
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32618-32625
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03961D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Klara Verheles, Magdalena Wojtas, Artur Podhorodecki
Dual-ligand stabilization of CdTe QDs using MPA and NAC enables precise size control and enhanced quantum yield (66%), achieving water-soluble, photostable nanocrystals with tunable NIR emission for biomedical and optoelectronic applications.
